title: Cache Rust builds in CI, add test:all, standardize on Node 24, align intake status codes
description:
CI runs take 18 to 23 minutes because every run builds the pinned Kanbus API and the accounts bridge with `cargo build --release` and no cache, and re-clones the pinned checkouts. The workflow installs Node 22 then Node 24 mid-run; the evaluation Lambda is Node 22 while the accounts Lambdas are Node 24. `npm test` runs a fraction of the suites and the docs reference a `test:canonical:durable` script that does not exist. Local intake answers 202 and hosted intake 200 for the same accepted submission.

Scope: Rust and checkout caching in CI; one Node 24; `test:all`; 202 everywhere; fix the duplicated cache line in `amplify.yml`.

Acceptance: infra and amplify checks pass; a no-change CI run finishes well under 10 minutes after the first cached run.
